---
title: "Database Downloads"
subtitle: Download links for the clean SQLite databases
---

Each source has a **clean** database (`<source>_clean.sqlite`): the QC-passed end
product of the slim stage, with uncertain rows removed, units harmonised, and
grain-size split into its own table. The analyses on this site read these five
databases. Their table layout is on the
[DB Schema (Clean)](./db-schema-clean.qmd) page.

The clean databases are published as release assets on the **multised-slim**
repository (alongside the flagged slim databases), so the download links point
there.

## Merged database

The final **merged** database, combining all five sources into one, will be
published here once the cross-source merge is complete.

::: {.callout-note}
Each file is a self-contained SQLite database. For the table definitions see the
[DB Schema (Clean)](./db-schema-clean.qmd) page; for how the clean databases are
built from the slim stage, see the
[slim site](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-slim/) under **Clean
databases**.
:::
